children: Colombia’s real retail sales rose 7.3% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from 5.3% in the previous month but falling short of market expectations of 8.5%.

The strongest positive contributions came from sales of motor vehicles and motorcycles for household use (35.8%), other motor vehicles and motorcycles (26.2%), home appliances and furnishings (11.3%), and personal hygiene products, cosmetics and perfumes (10.2%).
However, growth remained constrained by declines in sales of computer and telecommunications equipment for personal and home use (-4.7%) and clothing and textiles (-5.9%).
Meanwhile, employment in the retail sector increased by 1.4% year-on-year, up from 1% a month prior.

title: Colombia Retail Sales Growth Picks Up
